subsystems.name: Pretrained content encoders (text/image/audio/video/code)
subsystems.evidence: Gate E rerun on a fresh cache: E.1 4 real modalities (5 with code), 0 stubs, min 22.7M params, reference cosines 1.0/0.999999/1.0; E.2 min separation 15.1; E.n1 9 forward passes and weight-dependent vectors in all 5 modalities. Own probe (CPU): paraphrase 0.831, numbers changed 0.831, negation 'safe' vs 'not safe' 0.965, sentiment flip 0.824, other topic -0.013; one-word edit at the end of a 3,200-word article 0.9997; image JPEG q60 0.956 vs colour change 0.881; audio other words 0.608; video reversed frame order 0.869.
key_defects: Text vectors blind to negation, polarity and quantities (mean-pooled MiniLM): materially different content looks like a paraphrase
Long-document dilution: local edits vanish (0.9997)
Hard AST speech gate at 0.5 (audio.py:60) drops transcripts of borderline speech (observed 0.563)
Video ignores subtitle/caption streams ('available transcripts')
No structured product representation (4.3 'software and products')
subsystems.work_needed: Add fine-grained semantic channels (NLI/cross-encoder or a stronger sentence model for polarity and negation, numeric and entity features), position-aware long-document pooling, a soft speech gate, caption-stream ingestion, and a product encoder (listing, price, features, reviews). Extend the E.2 suites with fine-grained changes and require separation there.

subsystems.name: Embedding cache and world embed record
subsystems.evidence: E.4 reproduced (0 failures, 10 hits, 5 recomputes). Own probe: disk hit identical, a one-word edit recomputed, 1 embed.recorded event (internal) for 2 calls, identical vector on the repeat. With TextEncoder.window changed 254->32 the cache key stayed the same and a stale vector was served (cosine 0.83 to the fresh one); the key carries no torch/transformers version and no device.
key_defects: The preprocessing dict is hand-written (text.py:49-51), not derived from the parameters used: computation changes do not invalidate
CODE_VERSION is a manual bump (base.py:13)
Library versions and device not in the key
The E.4 test constructs the 'new version' keys itself (tautological)
subsystems.work_needed: Derive the preprocessing hash from the live encoder attributes plus a source hash of the encoder modules; include library versions (and optionally device class) in the version; make E.4 mutate a real encoder parameter.

subsystems.name: Encoder to participant-behaviour integration (aud semantic path, E.3 probes)
subsystems.evidence: No probe is registered (E.3 fails, p=1.0). The default aud.encoder is lexical random indexing (audience.py:112). The semantic path randomly projects MiniLM into the 32-d lexical interest space (audience.py:470-479). Probe: on-topic minus off-topic affinity 0.425 lexical vs -0.011+/-0.046 semantic. Integrated two-world run (1,500 people, 3 days): topic match opened/not-opened 0.444/0.250 lexical vs 0.171/0.221 semantic; Spearman(topic match, watch_s) 0.203 vs 0.026.
key_defects: The pretrained encoders never drive behaviour by default
The semantic path makes the audience content-blind (space mismatch)
Population interests live in two different lexical spaces (population/text token_vec vs social/textrep word_vector)
E.3 probe registry empty
subsystems.work_needed: Represent interests in the encoder space (or learn or calibrate a mapping from engagement data), make the pretrained encoders the default content representation in v5 social worlds (cached, once per artifact), register E.3 probes for text, image, audio and video in the real consumption engine, and add a negative control (random vectors must give no effect).

subsystems.evidence: Gate E rerun: creator_assigned_quality_fields_read=5 (domains/firms.py:290,295,711; social/reference.py:151), so the test fails. Inspection: both look like false positives (task quality from the labour market; a lexical relevance method).
key_defects: Name-regex static scan only (audit.py:32-35): it cannot detect score proxies under other names or data flow
Fails on the merged tree
subsystems.work_needed: Triage the 5 hits (pragma or rename), and add a dynamic invariance test: vary creator-controlled metadata (title, tags, description, declared fields) with the bytes fixed and show behaviour is unchanged; vary the bytes and show it changes.

subsystems.name: Shared small-LM inference service
subsystems.evidence: 12 unit tests passed; own probe: cap enforced (500->20), 16/16 prefix hits, deterministic, one weights object for two services. Gate H: one weight copy for 8 participants, 237.5 tok/s, peak 5,813 MiB; prefix-cache speedup 0.986, identical outputs with the cache 5/8 (bf16).
key_defects: Prefix cache yields no speedup and is not exact in bf16
Batches only within one act_batch call (no cross-caller continuous batching)
No selective-GPU policy or per-capability model routing
int8 is CPU-only and its quality was never benchmarked
Used only by semantic participants, which nothing integrates
subsystems.work_needed: Make prefix reuse exact (fp32 prefix or no reuse in bf16) or measure and document the drift; share an inference queue across all semantic callers in a world; add capability routing (0.6B default, 1.7B for programming, negotiation and strategy per SP-3.2b); benchmark the quantized variants.

subsystems.name: Recorded semantic inference module
subsystems.evidence: Unit tests: replay and regenerate without the model (the model call is patched to fail), operator-only tool hidden from in-world actors, module passes admission. key_defects: Prompts are not recoverable from the log (digests only): post-hoc decision audits need the staged prompts archived separately
subsystems.work_needed: Optionally archive the full prompts as evaluator-only artifacts, for auditing.

subsystems.name: Semantic participants (policy, retrieval, argument filling, BatchedRunner)
subsystems.evidence: Gate H rerun: 129 actions, 74 rejected (57%), 2/8 goals, 15 consequential actions of which only 2 serve a goal (13 junk: bank.open_account x4 after the goal was met, cal.create x6 titled 'cal', mail.send x3 with body 'mail.send'). Per-participant dump: argument values are often echoed prompt fragments (board '- forum.post: {...', url '-502'); ana never called docs.create, eli never created the repository, cara never mailed dev. World regenerated without the model to the same digest. No module outside semantic/ uses SemanticParticipant or SemanticGroup. Observations contain no reward (identity/bank/mail only); runner reward 0 without objectives.
key_defects: Ephemeral Python policy objects outside the world: memory and history not persisted with snapshots or forks (no persistent identity)
Requires an evaluator-assigned text goal: no operation without an objective, no self-generated goals or needs
Only hostable in 4.0 worldgen families
Weak in-world competence (57% rejected calls; argument values are echoed prompt fragments)
No notion of goal completion: ben kept acting for 23 turns after paying
No adaptation or learning
